_about: presentationSafe decisions for questions new in 2026.10.0. The original 107 keep their published value (true). v1 of the app does not read this field (README: reserved), so it changes no runtime behaviour yet; it records the editorial judgement for a future present-mode filter.
criteria: BUILD_PROMPT.md §6 topic exclusions (dating, politics, alcohol, health, money, family status) plus prompts that assume or probe a private family/partner situation or personal finances, which could push a vulnerable disclosure in front of a shared screen.
